title: Revvity Launches SuperFlex Prenatal Screening System, Expanding Access to Preeclampsia Testing
summary: Revvitys new maternal and fetal biochemistry testing platform Designed for accessibility, simplicity, and flexibility Purpose-built for small to mid-sized labs and clinics to enable this capability in-house for the first time WALTHAM, Mass. August 10, 2026 Revvity, Inc. today announced the launch of the SuperFlex(tm) prenatal screening system , a compact, CE-IVDR certified immunoassay instrument designed to bring high-quality screening to laboratories and clinics seeking reliable, rapid solutions that fit lower-volume workflows. The system supports testing for preeclampsia, a condition that affects between 2% and 8% of pregnancies and is increasing globally due to rising maternal age and conditions such as diabetes and hypertension. Despite international guidelines recommending screening, access has historically been limited to high-throughput centralized laboratories.
